Rethinking Backend Development

MSUO™Application Orchestration Kernel

MSUO™ is a general-purpose, pro-code application orchestration kernel designed for rapid, low-maintenance backend development, and deterministic AI code generation.

For Web Developers, IoT Engineers, and Long-Suffering Boilerplate Coders.

MSUO Developer API Documentation
Meta-Schema Universal Orchestration™

For engineers who work from first principles, MSUO simplifies backend development through its reusable architecture and unified Meta-Schema. It brings the directness of desktop application development to the backend and removes repetitive boilerplate.

For teams using AI-assisted development, MSUO enables code generation at scale while keeping them in control of their architecture, source code, and intellectual property.

Kernel architecture

Deterministic Architecture for Agentic Code-Generation

AI-generated application logic may be probabilistic in origin, but its integration, execution relationships, and architectural boundaries need not be. MSUO provides a deterministic orchestration model within which such logic can operate.

Schema-Agnostic

Develop applications without tying the kernel's orchestration model to a predefined application data schema.

Domain-Agnostic

Apply the same kernel and development model across business applications, web systems, IoT solutions, and beyond.

Dynamic & Adaptive Persistence

MSUO employs an adaptive differential persistence mechanism, enabling structural data operations and database persistence through a unified data model.

Unified Application Orchestration

Supply the standard Component structure in a request, and orchestrate any GUI through MSUO's unified data and logic model.
